title: Top 10 Marketing Strategies for Small Businesses in Australia | POSApt

facts.fact: Research cited by POSApt shows 81% of consumers use Google reviews to evaluate a business and make buying decisions.
facts.quote: Research shows 81% of consumers[use Google reviews](https://billo.app/benefits-of-google-reviews/)to evaluate a business and make buying decisions.

facts.fact: Constant Contact reports email marketing has an ROI of 42:1, as cited by POSApt.
facts.quote: email marketing with an insane ROI of 42:1 as reported by[Constant Contact]

facts.fact: POSApt recommends small businesses that have just started selling spend at least $1000 to $3000 a month on marketing.
facts.quote: Small businesses, that have just started selling should spend at least $1000 to $3000 a month on marketing.

facts.fact: POSApt cites a Black Friday sale example offering a 20% discount on every product as a popular marketing tactic.
facts.quote: black friday sale with 20% discount on every product are quite popular.

facts.fact: POSApt states that Google My Business profiles appear as the first 3 results on Google with map location when searching 'something near me'.
facts.quote: It’s the first 3 results you see on Google with their map location when you search for ‘something near me’.

facts.fact: POSApt states the article was published on 2026-07-04.
The page advises small businesses focused on maintaining current sales levels to spend 5% to 7% of total revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: Spend 5% to 7% of your total revenue if you’re focused on maintaining your current sales levels.

facts.fact: The page advises small businesses aiming to expand and stay competitive to spend 7% to 10% of total revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: Spend 7% to 10% of your total revenue if you’re aiming to expand your business and stay competitive.

facts.fact: The page advises small businesses looking to dominate their target market to spend 10% to 15% of total revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: Spend 10% to 15% of your total revenue if you’re looking to dominate your target market

facts.fact: The page states that the revenue-percentage marketing budget figures should be considered in relation to competitors' marketing budgets.
facts.quote: However, bear in mind that these numbers should be considered in relation to your competitors’ marketing budgets.
